descriptions.text: Hit while walking? Insurers may blame you. An attorney reviews your case for free.
Tell us what happened. No upfront costs, and no fee unless we win. Free, no obligation.
Outside the crosswalk, or a hit-and-run? That does not end a claim by itself. Call 24/7.
Attorney Alina Landver began on the defense side and knows how insurers undervalue claims.
